body_markdown:
**Allient Defense Receives Best in Show Award at AUSA 2026**


[Download printer-friendly version](https://allient.com/d/?h=2d98ee4)


**Buffalo, N.Y. – 22 October, 2026 –** **** Allient Inc. (Nasdaq: ALNT) (“Allient” or the “Company”), a global designer and manufacturer of specialty Motion, Controls, Power and lightweighting composite / advanced materials products and solutions for targeted industries and applications, has announced that Allient Defense was voted Best in Show at the Association of the United States Army (AUSA) 2026 Annual Meeting & Exposition, held October 12–14 in Washington, D.C.


The award recognizes Allient Defense’s Heroic Engineering campaign, which created an experience that connected with attendees while showcasing the company’s technologies and solutions.


“We’re proud to receive this recognition for our work at AUSA 2026,” said Steve Warzala, President of Allient Defense. “The Heroic Engineering campaign was the result of a tremendous collaborative effort, and this award reflects the creativity, dedication and hard work of everyone involved. We’re grateful to our partners for helping bring the campaign to life, as well as to the entire Allient team for their commitment and support.”


Allient Defense would like to thank AUSA for the recognition and the opportunity to showcase the campaign to attendees, as well as its campaign partners Agency 15, RES Exhibit Services and Technology Online Group for their collaboration, creativity and dedication throughout the campaign.


For more information about Allient Defense, visit[here](https://allient.com/allient-defense/) .


**ABOUT ALLIENT INC.**


Allient (Nasdaq: ALNT) is a global engineering and manufacturing enterprise that develops solutions to drive the future of market-moving industries, including medical, life sciences, aerospace and defense, industrial automation, robotics, semi-conductor, transportation, agriculture, construction, and facility infrastructure. A family of globally responsible companies, Allient takes a One-Team approach to “Connect What Matters” and provides the most robust, reliable, and high-value products and systems by utilizing its core Motion, Controls, and Power technologies and platforms.


Headquartered in Buffalo, N.Y., Allient employs more than 2,500 team members around the world.
